summary.text: Ryan Braunberger is the Democratic-NPL nominee for Secretary of State and a Fargo state senator. He says he is running to boost public trust in elections; in July 2026 he agreed with Howe that North Dakota's voter data and results are secure.

paragraphs.text: He earned an associate degree in business administration from Southeastern Technical College in 2007 and a bachelor's degree in social work from Minnesota State University Moorhead in 2022.
Braunberger was first elected in 2022 to represent District 10, in Fargo, in the North Dakota Senate, where he serves as Senate Minority Caucus Leader.
His legislative biography lists his occupation as transportation specialist.
